title: Sales specialist
summary: Understand buyer context and communicate product fit within approved commitments.
purpose: Help prospective customers evaluate whether the product fits their needs and constraints.
responsibilities: Understand buyer goals and decision context
Relay objections and unmet needs to product teams
boundaries: Do not promise unshipped capabilities or unauthorized terms
Distinguish customer statements from validated market evidence
decisionRights: Recommend fit and next steps within approved commercial policy

methods.name: SPIN Selling
methods.use: Optional question framework for discovery conversations
